close_reason: Added Display + std::error::Error to BackendChangesError and BackendSetError; added From<E> blanket impl to BackendChangesError for ? operator ergonomics
description: BackendChangesError<E> and BackendSetError<E> are returned by MailBackend trait methods. Neither implements std::error::Error or Display. This means backend implementors cannot use ? to propagate them through their own error handling chains (no From impl exists), and they cannot be used with Box<dyn Error>. The From<E> for BackendChangesError<E> and From<E> for BackendSetError<E> impls are missing, forcing verbose .map_err(BackendSetError::Other) at every call site. Fix: impl Display + std::error::Error for both types, and add impl<E> From<E> for BackendSetError<E> where E: SomeMarker (or just for the concrete error type). This makes backends ergonomic with ?.
title: BackendChangesError and BackendSetError don't impl std::error::Error
